title: gymnosporia crenata

It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Gymnosporia crenata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the management of pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities.
